errors.noKey: You are not logged in. Log in from the app settings.
errors.invalidKey: The saved API key is no longer valid. Log in again from the app settings.
errors.invalidCredentials: Login failed. Check your username and password. Use your phone number with country code (for example +46701234567) if you registered with it, otherwise your email address.
errors.unexpectedResponse: Glue answered in a way the app did not expect, so no key could be created.
errors.timeout: The Glue service did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the Glue service. Check your internet connection.
errors.notConfirmed: Glue accepted the command, but the lock did not confirm within 20 seconds. The status updates if it goes through later.
errors.lockUnreachable: The lock is offline. The Glue hub cannot reach it.
errors.server: The Glue cloud has a temporary server error (status {{status}}). The lock may be affected, try again in a moment.
errors.hubUnreachable: The Glue cloud cannot reach the hub, so the lock cannot be controlled from here right now. Try restarting the hub (unplug it for a moment) or control the lock manually over Bluetooth in the Glue app.

device.offline: Offline: the Glue hub cannot reach the lock.
device.gone: This lock no longer exists in your Glue account.
device.badKey: Not logged in. Log in again from the app settings.

status.sent: Command accepted. Waiting for the lock…
status.retrying: Glue did not answer, trying again…

device.disconnected: The Glue cloud cannot reach the hub. Restart the hub or use Bluetooth in the Glue app.

settings.title: Glue Lock
settings.intro: Log in with your Glue account. Your password is only used once to create an API key and is never stored. Only the key is saved on your Homey.
settings.loggedIn: Logged in. An API key is saved on this Homey.
settings.loginDone: Logged in. Use Test connection to check it.
settings.logoutDone: Logged out. The key has been removed from this Homey. You can also revoke it in your Glue account.
settings.advanced: Advanced: enter an API key manually
settings.saved: The key is saved. Use Test connection to check it.

pair.title: Log in to Glue
pair.intro: Use your Glue account. Your password is only used once to create an API key and is never stored.
pair.already: You are already logged in. Continue to choose locks, or log in again with another account.
